entries.proposed_scope: Synthetic contract fixture for a boundary-conditioned tensor-noise bridge; no empirical claim.
entries.quantum_field_and_state: Electromagnetic field in a declared stationary Gaussian boundary state.

stress_energy.renormalized_t_munu_prescription: Point-split renormalized expectation relative to the declared open-boundary reference state.
stress_energy.subtraction_reference_state: Open-boundary apparatus state at matched material and thermodynamic controls.
stress_energy.frame_and_basis: Laboratory orthonormal tetrad in the weak-field apparatus frame.
stress_energy.boundary_and_surface_terms: Plate, coating, support, and surface counterterm contributions retained in the source ledger.

stress_noise.tensor_noise_kernel_prescription: Connected symmetrized stress-energy bitensor with the same subtraction state.

causal_response.retarded_tensor_to_metric_kernel: Gauge-fixed retarded linearized Einstein operator inverse acting on the tensor source and noise.
causal_response.gauge_and_coordinate_contract: Lorenz-gauge weak-field perturbation in laboratory coordinates.
causal_response.constraint_contract: Linearized Hamiltonian and momentum constraints with conserved source residual below tolerance.
causal_response.fourier_convention: X(omega)=integral dt exp(+i omega t) X(t); inverse uses exp(-i omega t)/(2 pi).
causal_response.units_contract: SI tensor components, angular frequency in rad/s, two-sided PSD per rad/s.

matter_dynamics.metric_to_matter_coherence_equation: Synthetic frozen Markovian influence-functional reduction mapped to the prepared path-density difference.

parameter_contract.frozen_ranges_or_priors: Synthetic proper bounded ranges frozen before the synthetic unblinding timestamp.

validity.domain_of_validity: Stationary Gaussian field state, weak metric perturbations, declared geometry band, and Markovian coarse-graining.
validity.uncertainty_model: Joint covariance over material response, tensor discretization, kernel interpolation, and coherence estimator.

companion_observable.prediction_contract: The same frozen kernel predicts the independent force-noise companion channel.

experiment_internal: Fail if held-out material, distance, temperature, path-swap, or echo dependence departs from the frozen kernel outside uncertainty.
independent: Fail if an independently calibrated force-noise measurement excludes the shared frozen kernel parameters.
